results.case: totals identical: no advisory strip (no spurious fire)
totals delta: Saved $X — current $Y advisory strip
totals delta downward: minus sign + absolute delta
totals eps: |delta| == 0.005 does not fire; 0.006 fires
totals unsaved: null saved -> no strip
totals blocked: saved total persists while current unavailable
panel manual: no precedence note when no tier/engine
panel tier: precedence note when applied tier shadows manual price
panel tier-equal: no note when tier total matches baseline (no spurious fire)
panel tier-unsaved: no note while tier applied but no saved total yet
panel tier+override: note still fires — tier shadows both manual fields
panel engine: engine-config note names the precedence chain
mobile: delta strip wraps cleanly at 390px
